test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The Union Budget 2024-25 introduced the Prime Minister’s package, comprising how many schemes and initiatives, aimed at providing employment, skilling, and other opportunities to 4.1 crore youth over a five-year period?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Five**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Union Budget 2024-25 introduced the Prime Minister's package comprising five schemes and initiatives.
 
• The package is aimed at providing employment, skilling, and other opportunities.
 
• It targets 4.1 crore youth over a five-year period.
 
• The initiative is part of the government's broader strategy to address unemployment and skill gaps in the country.
 
• These schemes are expected to boost economic growth by enhancing the employability of the youth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Employment Generation**

 
 
• Employment generation refers to the creation of jobs and opportunities for the working-age population.
 
• It is a key indicator of economic health and social stability.
 
• Government schemes often target sectors with high potential for job creation, such as manufacturing and services.
 
 
 
• **Skill Development**
 
 
• Skill development focuses on training individuals to enhance their capabilities and job readiness.
 
• It includes vocational training, technical education, and soft skills improvement.
 
• Skilling initiatives are crucial for meeting the demands of a rapidly changing job market.
 
 
 
• **Economic Growth**
 
 
• Economic growth is the increase in the market value of goods and services produced by an economy over time.
 
• It is typically measured as the percent rate of increase in real gross domestic product (GDP).
 
• Employment and skill development are integral to sustaining long-term economic growth.
 
 
 
• **Youth Unemployment**
 
 
• Youth unemployment refers to the jobless rate among individuals aged 15-24.
 
• High youth unemployment can lead to social unrest and economic instability.
 
• Governments often implement specific programs to target youth unemployment and enhance employability.
